title: Insurance Companies
definition: Insurance companies are specialized financial intermediaries that pool risk from individuals and corporate entities, collecting periodic premiums to indemnify them against specified future losses while mobilizing long-term domestic savings for capital markets.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial microtopic under Economy (Money and Banking / Financial Sector). Tested in Prelims via institutional mandates (IRDAI, FDI limits, statutory bodies) and in Mains GS-3 regarding financial inclusion, social security schemes, long-term infrastructure financing, and risk mitigation.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Insurance Companies.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Core foundational concepts of Banking and Financial Markets
